entities.name: UDP-N-acetylmuramate-L-alanine ligase
observations: The supplied 469-aa sequence exactly matches reviewed UniProt C1D5L5 from Laribacter hongkongensis; annotation gives EC 6.3.2.8 and peptidoglycan biosynthesis function.
Rhea RHEA:23372 reaction: UDP-N-acetyl-alpha-D-muramate + L-alanine + ATP = UDP-N-acetyl-alpha-D-muramoyl-L-alanine + ADP + phosphate + H(+).
